### What was implemented
- Expanded long-form content on all major public/indexable pages:
  - `index.html`
  - `sun-sign-calculator.html`
  - `moon-sign-calculator.html`
  - `rising-sign-calculator.html`
  - `about.html`
  - `privacy-policy.html`
- Content is human-readable, structured with clear headings, and naturally mapped to Sun/Moon/Rising intent without stuffing.
- Added shared location autocomplete in `app.js` and applied it across all calculator roots (`[data-calc-root]`):
  - Prefix + contains matching while typing
  - Scrollable dropdown suggestions
  - Keyboard support: `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `Enter`, `Escape`
  - Mouse click selection fills the input
  - Lightweight built-in city/state/country dataset for frontend use
- Styled dropdown to match existing dark premium theme in `styles.css`.
- Validation run:
  - JavaScript syntax check executed for `app.js` (`node --check app.js`) and passed.
  - No package-based lint/build config was present (no `package.json` found), so no npm lint/build step could be run.

### Exact PowerShell commands (copy-paste ready)

#### 1) Find the actual current project path
```powershell
$project = Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop" -Directory -Filter "BIGThreeAstrology*" |
  Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
  Select-Object -First 1

$project.FullName
```

#### 2) Open/view project files
```powershell
# Open project folder in Explorer
ii $project.FullName

# Open key files in Notepad
notepad (Join-Path $project.FullName "index.html")
notepad (Join-Path $project.FullName "app.js")
notepad (Join-Path $project.FullName "styles.css")

# If VS Code is installed, open whole project
code $project.FullName
```

#### 3) Create ZIP of CURRENT latest project (avoids self-copy error)
```powershell
$project = Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop" -Directory -Filter "BIGThreeAstrology*" |
  Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
  Select-Object -First 1

$zipPath = Join-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop" ("{0}-LATEST-{1}.zip" -f $project.Name, (Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"))

# Remove existing file only if same name exists
if (Test-Path $zipPath) { Remove-Item $zipPath -Force }

# IMPORTANT: destination zip is outside project folder, so no self-copy/include-itself issue
Compress-Archive -Path (Join-Path $project.FullName "*") -DestinationPath $zipPath -CompressionLevel Optimal -Force

Write-Host "ZIP created at: $zipPath"
```

#### 4) Verify ZIP contents quickly
```powershell
$zipPath = Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop" -Filter "*BIGThreeAstrology*LATEST*.zip" |
  Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
  Select-Object -First 1

Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem
$zip = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::OpenRead($zipPath.FullName)
$zip.Entries | Select-Object -First 20 FullName, Length
$zip.Dispose()
$zipPath.FullName
```
